lines.text: TeamLogic IT, with HexaView. From managed IT, to managed security.
Your clients don't want more tools. Their customers, insurers and auditors want security they can prove.
But a 24/7 SOC means hiring analysts, buying tooling and running night shifts. That's a different business.
So here's the partnership. TeamLogic IT keeps the brand, the client and the margin. HexaShield runs the platform and the analysts, behind the line.
It all runs from the HexaView Partner Console: your whole client book, its health, and what needs you today, in one place.
Switch services on per client: fully managed, co-managed or advisory. Start with one capability, and grow to all six.
Provision a new client in minutes, fully isolated, and connected to the tools they already run. No rip and replace.
Brand it once. Your logo, your colors and your domain, across every client console, report and sign-in.
Your clients see TeamLogic IT, end to end. One resilience score, every capability, and evidence on demand.
And when a threat lands at 3 a.m., it's met by analysts on shift, following the sun. Not a pager.
Register your deals and keep them protected. Wholesale in, your price out, and the margin stays with you.
From signed partner to first live client in as little as thirty to sixty days.
Grow your security practice, without growing a SOC. Ask for a Partner Console walkthrough. TeamLogic IT, powered by HexaShield.
